# Section break

**Foundation group:** page structure  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use a GOV.UK section break on an hr element to create a thematic break with standard spacing and an optional visible rule.

## Rules

- Use an hr element with govuk-section-break when the content has a genuine thematic break.
- Select govuk-section-break--m, --l or --xl for the required standard margin.
- Add govuk-section-break--visible only when users need a visible separator; the default break is represented by spacing alone.

## Accessibility contract

- Use the native hr semantic only for a thematic change, not as decoration.
- Do not rely on the separator line as the only cue that a new subject or task begins.

## Restrictions and caveats

- Do not use empty div elements, repeated hyphens or CSS borders as substitutes for the documented section-break contract.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.border`
- `govuk.spacing.static.3`
- `govuk.spacing.static.6`
- `govuk.spacing.static.9`

## Examples

### Large visible section break

```html
<hr class="govuk-section-break govuk-section-break--l govuk-section-break--visible">
```
